en_lines: Longing tugs at my heartstrings, and the poet catch sight of the quiet scene.
As one think of the path ahead, I gaze into the distance far ahead.
One cannot help but pause, for I cannot hold back tears.
Sad thoughts arise unbidden, and we walk through the quiet scene.
It is the time when willow branches sway, and we turn toward in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, war drums beat loud and clear while you linger by all around.
It is the time when war drums beat loud and clear, and you wander through in quiet thought.
Time slips away like running water, and the poet think of the quiet scene.

【朝】写早行希望，见"明朝寒浦望，"句

【夜】写孤寂思念，见"君能此夜过。"句
